Class Config

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.Config
public class Config extends Object
Configuration values for tree algorithms.
Author:
Ben Homer, 2014.

  • Field Summary

    Fields
    Modifier and Type
    Field
    Description
    static final boolean
    COMPARE_ALL_HEURISTICS
    If true the tree planter tries several heuristics in the tree planting stage to find a tree with the best complexity characteristics.
    static final int
    COMPLEXITY_CHECK_LEVEL
    Determines which complexities are checked when comparing heuristics, when COMPARE_ALL_HEURISTICS is true, as follows: 0 = best time complexity 1 = best space complexity 2 = best overall/combined complexity (space and time) 3 = based on number of partially covered classes in whole tree.
    static final MathContext
    Context
    The context to use for BigDecimal calculations.
    static final int
    FEEDBACK_FILTERING_OVERLAP_POP_THRESHOLD
    The feedback filtering approach is only attempted if the overlapped population between the child stations if greater than the specified value.
    static final boolean
    LOG
    All verbose outputs are written to log file if true.
    static final int
    MAX_TREE_PLANT_ATTEMPTS
    The max number of tree plant attempts allowed before the algorithm terminates in a failed state.
    static final int
    NUM_THREADS
    Specifies the number of threads to be used when running the tree algorithms.
    static final boolean
    Q_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY
    Indicates whether mean queue lengths should be computed individually/sequentially for each station m and class k, or if g arrays for all classes k should be calculated and stored in a tree node simultaneously.
    static final boolean
    RECURSIVE
    Indicates whether a recursive or iterative approach is used to traverse the tree.
    static final boolean
    TERMINATE_IF_HIGH_COMPLEXITY
    Specifies whether the algorithm should terminate if the complexity manager repeatedly decides that the tree algorithm is not the best approach, given the tree planted in the 'tree planting' stage of the algorithm.
    static final TreePlanter.PlantMode
    TREE_PLANT_MODE
    The tree planting mode to use if COMPARE_ALL_HEURISTICS is false.
    static final boolean
    USE_FEEDBACK_FILTERING
    If true then uses the feedback filtering approach to compute the g array at nodes where both children are leaves, and at least one of them is a fixed-rate station.
    static final boolean
    VERBOSE
    Each step of the algorithm is printed to the console if true.
    static final boolean
    X_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY
    Indicates whether throughputs should be computed individually/sequentially.

    • Q_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY

      public static final boolean Q_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY
      Indicates whether mean queue lengths should be computed individually/sequentially for each station m and class k, or if g arrays for all classes k should be calculated and stored in a tree node simultaneously. For detail see Lam/Lien paper sec. 4.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • X_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY

      public static final boolean X_COMPUTE_SEQUENTIALLY
      Indicates whether throughputs should be computed individually/sequentially.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • USE_FEEDBACK_FILTERING

      public static final boolean USE_FEEDBACK_FILTERING
      If true then uses the feedback filtering approach to compute the g array at nodes where both children are leaves, and at least one of them is a fixed-rate station. N.B. Leave this as true for good performance on networks with large populations.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values
